description: List all retailers (shops) currently authorized by a brand on authorized.by. Read-only. Use this to list a brand's authorized shops; to check one shop by its domain or URL, use verify_retailer_authorization. Sorted by subscription plan (PREMIUM, then START, then FREE) and then by brand-connection count descending. Each retailer includes shop_url, seal_implemented (whether the authorized.by seal is live on their shop), official_shop, partnership_date, and certificate_url / certificate_url_de: links to the public authorized.by certificate page (English / German) proving this specific brand-retailer authorization. Share the certificate link when a user needs verifiable proof. Only active partnerships are returned: confirmed by both the brand and the retailer, with both profiles public and the brand approved by authorized.by. Revoked or pending partnerships are never listed. Responses are cached and refreshed when the underlying profile or partnership changes, so a revocation may take a short time to disappear. partnership_date is the date the authorization STARTED, not the date it was last verified; a partnership listed here is currently active as of the response time. Data scope: results only cover relationships registered and confirmed on authorized.by. An empty result or a not-found error does NOT prove that no authorization exists outside authorized.by. Distinguish outcomes: an empty list means no matching record on authorized.by; an error result whose text starts with 'Brand not found' or 'Retailer not found' means the given id/alias is unknown; an error result whose text starts with 'Tool execution failed' is a technical error and says nothing about the data.

id_or_alias.description: Brand numeric ID, slug or alias.

name: get_brand_retailers

outputSchema.description: All retailers currently authorized by the brand, with per-retailer certificate links.

brand_id.description: Numeric ID of the brand the list belongs to.

premium_count.description: Number of listed retailers on the PREMIUM plan.

brand_count.description: Number of brands that currently authorize this retailer on authorized.by.

certificate_url.description: Public authorized.by certificate page (English) that proves the authorization; null when there is no active authorization.

certificate_url_de.description: Same certificate page in German; null when there is no active authorization.

description.description: Description text in German (de) and English (en); each may be null.

opening_hours.description: Weekly opening hours of the physical store; empty or null when unknown.

payment_methods.description: Accepted payment methods; null when unknown.

registration_date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the company registered on authorized.by.

social.description: Social media profile URLs; each may be null.

trustami.description: Customer rating from Trustami; fields are null when no rating exists.

profile_url.description: URL of the rating profile, or null.

review_count.description: Number of customer reviews, or null.

tuv_certification_date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the TÜV certification was granted; null when not certified.

id.description: Numeric authorized.by ID. Accepted by the id_or_alias argument of the detail tools.

official_shop.description: Whether this shop is the brand's own official shop.

partnership_date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the authorization STARTED. Not a last-verified date: every listed partnership is active as of the response.

plan.description: authorized.by subscription plan of the retailer: PREMIUM, START or FREE.

product_count.description: Number of products registered on authorized.by; null when unknown.

seal_implemented.description: Whether the authorized.by seal is live on the retailer's shop.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier. Accepted by the id_or_alias argument of the detail tools.

sponsored.description: Whether the brand sponsors (highlights) this retailer.

tuv_certified.description: Whether the retailer holds a TÜV certification via authorized.by.

total.description: Number of entries in the list.

tuv_certified_count.description: Number of listed retailers with a TÜV certification.

title: List a brand's authorized retailers
